info.title: Domain Intelligence API
info.description: WHOIS/RDAP, DNS, SSL/TLS, subdomains and email security (SPF, DMARC, DKIM) for any domain, in one REST call. /lookup/{domain} runs all five lookups in parallel; each section is also its own endpoint. If one section fails it is returned as an object with an `error` field and the rest of the response is unaffected. Successful results are cached per section: DNS 5 min, WHOIS 1 h, SSL 6 h, subdomains 24 h, email security 1 h. Source code (MIT): https://github.com/osiris-technical-institute/domain-intelligence-api

get.description: Returns WHOIS, DNS, SSL, subdomains and email security in one call, fetched in parallel. `cached` shows which sections came from cache. Typical time is 1 to 5 s uncached and well under a second when cached; with `wait=1` it can take up to about 20 s.

parameters.name: domain
parameters.description: Bare hostname, e.g. example.com (no scheme or path). Punycode (xn--) is accepted.

parameters.name: wait
parameters.description: Set to 1 to wait for every subdomain source to finish (up to about 20 s) instead of returning the fast result. The live/historical split is added by a background check and appears in the cached result shortly after a domain's first lookup.

200.description: Successful response (long arrays in the example are shortened)

dkim.note: Probed common selectors (Google, Microsoft 365, Mailchimp, SendGrid, etc.). Custom or hash-based selectors aren't auto-discoverable.

get.description: Tries rdap.org, then the IANA RDAP bootstrap and the TLD's RDAP server, then 22 fixed RDAP servers, then port-43 WHOIS (61 TLD-specific servers, many ccTLDs without RDAP, IANA referral for unmapped TLDs). `_source` names the tier that answered. Registrant contact details are not returned; some registries (.uk, .nl) redact most fields by policy. Cached 1 h.

get.description: Sources run concurrently: crt.sh and certspotter (CT logs), hackertarget, rapiddns and VirusTotal (passive DNS), DNS brute-force with a 773-name wordlist across 8 public resolvers, and subfinder (25+ passive sources) in the background. Wildcard DNS is detected and brute-force is skipped on wildcard zones. By default the response returns after about 3 s and slow sources finish in the background, filling the cache; `wait=1` waits for every source. Every name is resolved again: `live` lists names that resolve now with their IP or CNAME target, ordered first in `subdomains`. Large shared-infrastructure subtrees are collapsed into `pools`. Up to 2,000 names per response; `count` is the full total. Cached 24 h.

get.description: SPF from the domain's TXT records, DMARC from _dmarc.{domain}, and DKIM keys found by probing 29 common selectors (Google Workspace, Microsoft 365, Mailchimp, SendGrid, Postmark, Mandrill, Klaviyo, Mailgun and generic names). Records are returned raw, not parsed. Custom or hash-based DKIM selectors can't be discovered. BIMI, MTA-STS and blocklist checks are not included. Cached 1 h.

200.description: Successful response (long arrays in the example are shortened)

cached.description: True for each section served from cache

created.description: As given by the registry, usually ISO 8601

_source.description: Tier that answered, e.g. rdap.org, iana-bootstrap:..., fallback:..., port43:whois.nic.fr

sans.description: Every DNS Subject Alternative Name on the certificate

signature_algorithm.description: e.g. sha256WithRSAEncryption or ecdsa-with-SHA384 (dotted OID if unnamed)

live_count.description: Names that resolve now. Absent until the liveness check has run.

live.description: Names that resolve now. Absent until the liveness check has run.

sources_used.description: Per-source status: 'name: N found', 'name: enriching', 'name: rate-limited', 'name: unavailable', 'name: skipped'; 'liveness: enriching' while the live check runs

warnings.description: Only present when fewer than 20 names were found and some sources failed

found.description: Selectors that returned a DKIM key

SectionError.description: Returned in place of a section that failed or timed out

attempts.description: WHOIS only: what each tier returned
